tagline: Bridge customer emails and engineering issues automatically
metaTitle: Linear Gmail Integration: Turn Emails into Linear Issues
metaDescription: Turn bug report emails into Linear issues linked to the original thread, with duplicates merged. GAIA drafts customer updates. See the setup steps.
intro:
Customer bug reports and feature requests arrive over email. Engineering teams track work in Linear. Manually translating between these two worlds creates delays, loses context, and frustrates both customers and engineers.

GAIA connects Gmail and Linear so customer-facing emails flow directly into your engineering workflow. Bug reports become issues with proper formatting and priority. Feature requests get logged to the backlog. When an issue is resolved, GAIA drafts the customer reply in Gmail. The loop closes automatically.

useCases.title: Bug report emails to Linear issues
useCases.description: GAIA reads customer emails reporting bugs, extracts the relevant details, and creates a properly formatted issue with title, description, and suggested priority based on the email's urgency.

useCases.title: Feature request logging
useCases.description: Feature requests arriving over email get converted into backlog items with the customer's exact wording preserved so product teams have authentic user voice attached to each request.

useCases.title: Customer status update drafts
useCases.description: When an issue is moved to 'Done', GAIA drafts a reply to the original customer email explaining the resolution, ready for a support agent to review and send.

useCases.title: Issue triage from email volume
useCases.description: When multiple customers email about the same problem, GAIA detects the pattern and creates a single high-priority issue rather than duplicating the ticket for each email.

useCases.title: Internal email-to-issue for team requests
useCases.description: Internal emails from non-technical stakeholders requesting changes or fixes get converted into properly formatted issues so engineering teams receive structured requests rather than vague email threads.

howItWorks.step: Connect Gmail and Linear to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Gmail and Linear accounts. Specify which team and project incoming email issues should be assigned to.
Tell GAIA which emails should become issues, by sender domain, label, subject keywords, or AI classification. Set default priority and assignee rules.

howItWorks.step: Close the loop with automated replies
howItWorks.description: Configure GAIA to draft email replies when issues reach specific statuses. You review drafts before sending, ensuring quality customer communication.

faqs.question: Can GAIA link issues back to the original Gmail thread?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA adds the thread URL to the issue description so engineers always have a link back to the original customer communication for full context.

faqs.question: Does GAIA deduplicate issues when multiple customers report the same bug?
faqs.answer: GAIA uses semantic similarity to detect when new emails describe already-existing issues and can add a comment to the existing issue instead of creating a duplicate.

faqs.question: Can non-engineering teams use this for their own Linear workspaces?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Any team that tracks projects in a workspace can use this automation. Marketing teams can log campaign requests from email, operations teams can log vendor requests, and design teams can log feedback.
